+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Build/run pinned external Athena++ reference, serially with finite limits.
+
+Third-party source/build trees stay outside the project. Frozen input and
+result data stay alongside this script. Running this script replaces only
+its own reference outputs.
+"""
+import hashlib
+import io
+import json
+import resource
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+import tarfile
+import time
+import urllib.request
+from pathlib import Path
+
+HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+meta = json.loads((HERE/"provenance.json").read_text())
+source = Path(meta["checkout"])
+if not source.exists():
+    blob = urllib.request.urlopen(meta["archive_url"], timeout=60).read()
+    assert hashlib.sha256(blob).hexdigest() == meta["sha256"]
+    source.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True, parents=True)
+    with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(blob), mode="r:gz") as archive:
+        archive.extractall(source.parent, filter="data")
+
+
+def limits():
+    resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS, (1536*2**20, 1536*2**20))
+    resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU, (300, 305))
+
+
+start = time.monotonic()
+with (HERE/"build.log").open("w") as log:
+    subprocess.run(meta["configure_command"], cwd=source, stdout=log,
+                   stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, check=True, timeout=60, preexec_fn=limits)
+    subprocess.run(meta["build_command"], cwd=source, stdout=log,
+                   stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, check=True, timeout=300, preexec_fn=limits)
+run = HERE/"output"
+run.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+shutil.copyfile(HERE/"athinput.bw", run/"athinput.bw")
+with (HERE/"run.log").open("w") as log:
+    subprocess.run([str(source/"bin/athena"), "-i", "athinput.bw"], cwd=run,
+                   stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, check=True,
+                   timeout=300, preexec_fn=limits)
+usage = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
+(HERE/"usage.json").write_text(json.dumps(dict(wall_seconds=time.monotonic()-start,
+                                                user_seconds=usage.ru_utime,
+                                                system_seconds=usage.ru_stime,
+                                                maxrss_kb=usage.ru_maxrss,
+                                                build_jobs=1, simulation_threads=1), indent=2)+"\n")
+print("Athena++ reference complete; wall seconds", time.monotonic()-start)
*** End Patch"));
